title: Notifications do not appear on Android 14

title: Undo does not work after paste

text.body: After pasting a block of text, Ctrl+Z does not undo the paste.

title: Feedback after migrating our team

text.body: We moved a team of twelve people over last month. Most things went smoothly: invitations, shared folders and the permissions screen. Two people asked for a compact list view. The weekly summary email is useful. One annoyance that everyone hit: undo does not work after paste, so Ctrl+Z leaves the pasted text in place and people delete it by hand. Also the export button could be easier to find. Overall a good experience.
